name: complydoc
title_zh: 发出去之前先数一遍文件夹里有几个身份证号
tagline_zh: 整包文档要喂给 LLM 前，先离线跑一遍：多少 token、多少页扫不清、夹着几张银行卡和 IBAN。全程不联网。
tagline_en: Before feeding a folder to an LLM: token cost, scan quality, and every national ID, card and IBAN inside — all.
desc_en: Audit a folder of documents offline for LLM processing cost, extraction readiness, and personal or financial identifiers (national IDs across the UK, US and EU, payment cards, IBANs, bank details). Use when asked what documents would cost to process with an LLM, how ready they are to extract from, whether a folder contains personal data, or to check documents for PII before sending them anywhere.
why_zh: 规则匹配而非模型判断，所以能给出可复核的命中位置；成本估算按真实分页和字符数算，不是拍脑袋的每页常数。
why_en: Regex and checksum rules, not a model guessing — every hit is locatable and re-checkable, and cost comes from real page and.
limit_zh: 只认英、美、欧的证件号格式和 IBAN、卡号，中文身份证、护照号一律不识别；只扫文本层。
limit_en: Only UK/US/EU ID formats, IBANs and card numbers — no Chinese IDs or passports. Text layer only; image-only scans need OCR first or it just reports.
title_en: Count the IDs in a folder before you send it anywhere
